us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic stories from the past 1–2 days

articles.title: Second federal judge blocks Trump mail-ballot order before Supreme Court review
bullets: A Washington, D.C., federal judge ordered USPS not to implement Trump’s order limiting mail balloting.
The ruling follows a separate Boston injunction already before the Supreme Court.
The judge cited risk that valid absentee or mail ballots could go uncounted in the midterms.

articles.title: Democrats and civil-rights groups prepare legal pushback over midterm election interference fears
bullets: Democrats and activist groups are organizing legal and public-response plans ahead of the midterms.
Courts have already halted Trump administration efforts to reshape election rules by executive action.
Denver and civil-rights groups sued to bar ICE from polling places, citing election-site protections.

articles.title: House speaker says Trump’s proposed $5,000 dividend would need Congress
bullets: Speaker Mike Johnson said Trump’s plan to send $5,000 to each U.S. adult requires congressional approval.
Trump had suggested the payments if Republicans keep control of Congress in November.
The proposal could cost more than $1 trillion, according to AP’s reporting.

articles.title: Trump accepts ethics language in Senate crypto bill, GOP senators say
bullets: Republican senators said Trump agreed to a major ethics provision in pending cryptocurrency legislation.
The provision is intended to apply to the president as part of the broader bill.
The legislation is headed for a key vote this week.

articles.title: AP analysis finds DOJ struggled to win felony assault cases against protesters
bullets: AP reviewed 102 protester cases involving alleged assaults on federal authorities in four cities.
The cases that reached trial ended in acquittal, mistrial or dismissal.
The remaining felony assault cases are scheduled for trial this fall.

global.label: Global
global.subtitle: Major worldwide developments from the past 1–2 days

articles.title: Saudi oil pipeline hit by strikes to remain mostly offline for weeks
bullets: Regional officials told AP a key Saudi oil pipeline will be largely out of service for weeks.
The damage follows attacks tied to the widening Yemen and Red Sea crisis.
Houthi advances have increased pressure on Saudi oil exports and global energy markets.

articles.title: Houthis seize strategic Red Sea islands as Middle East tensions deepen
bullets: Yemen’s Houthis seized additional islands near key Red Sea shipping routes.
The moves strengthen rebel control around the Bab el-Mandeb corridor.
Saudi Arabia is facing intensified pressure from Iran-backed groups during the wider regional war.

articles.title: Russian drone hits train near Ukraine-Poland border after dignitaries pass
bullets: A Russian drone struck a train near Ukraine’s border with Poland on Sunday.
The strike occurred shortly after visiting officials, including former UK and Swedish prime ministers, passed through.
The train route is a key link between Kyiv and Poland.

articles.title: Poland pledges stronger security after drone strikes near Ukraine border
bullets: Poland said it would strengthen security after drone strikes along the Ukrainian border region.
The pledge follows renewed Russian attacks affecting cross-border transport and infrastructure.
Warsaw has framed the incidents as a direct regional security concern.

articles.title: European leaders meet on Arctic shipping and Russian security buildup
bullets: European leaders gathered in Finland to discuss Arctic security and commercial access.
Climate change is opening new northern shipping routes and intensifying competition for resources.
Russia’s military buildup in the region is a central concern for European governments.

india.label: India News
india.subtitle: Top India-focused stories from the past 1–2 days

articles.title: Modi warns at BRICS that geopolitical tensions threaten global stability
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed BRICS leaders in New Delhi on Sunday.
He said conflicts, supply-chain shocks and climate crises are affecting ordinary people worldwide.
The summit brought together leaders including Xi Jinping, Vladimir Putin and Masoud Pezeshkian.

articles.title: Modi and Xi seek reset in India-China ties on BRICS sidelines
bullets: Modi and Chinese President Xi Jinping met during the BRICS summit in New Delhi.
The meeting was aimed at improving ties after years of strain following the 2020 border clash.
China said institutional exchanges have resumed and bilateral trade has expanded.

articles.title: BRICS announces four agriculture initiatives under New Delhi Declaration
bullets: BRICS leaders announced initiatives covering agroecology, regenerative agriculture and digital agriculture.
The declaration backed a farmer-centric BRICS AGRIN network for inputs, genetic resources and information.
Members also welcomed a forum on farmers’ rights in seed systems.

articles.title: India to host World Circular Economy Forum in Gandhinagar from September 15
bullets: India will host the World Circular Economy Forum 2026 in Gandhinagar, Gujarat.
The forum runs from September 15 to 18 under the theme of transition for people and prosperity.
The government expects more than 2,000 stakeholders from over 65 countries.

articles.title: India sends Bailey bridge components to flood-hit Nepal
bullets: India sent the first consignment for a 70-metre Bailey bridge to Nepal.
The bridge is intended to restore connectivity in the flood-affected Betrawati area.
The aid is part of India’s ongoing support after Nepal’s devastating flash floods.

stocks.label: US Stocks
stocks.subtitle: Top U.S. market movers and trading themes

articles.title: Nasdaq futures lead Wall Street lower after AI safety warnings
bullets: Nasdaq 100 futures fell sharply in early Monday trading.
The selloff followed calls by AI executives to slow frontier model development.
Reuters reported that tech losses could set the tone before this week’s Fed decision.

articles.title: Nvidia slides in premarket as AI-chip trade comes under pressure
bullets: Nvidia shares fell more than 2% in premarket trading, according to Reuters.
The decline came after AI leaders backed slower development for safety reasons.
Nvidia remains central to the AI infrastructure trade, making it a key market bellwether.

articles.title: Intel, AMD and Marvell drop as chipmakers sell off
bullets: Reuters reported Intel and Marvell down nearly 6% premarket.
AMD fell about 5% in the same early trading report.
The move reflected a broad pullback in semiconductor names tied to AI spending expectations.

articles.title: ServiceNow, Adobe and Workday rise as software stocks buck tech weakness
bullets: Reuters reported ServiceNow up about 3% premarket.
Adobe and Workday were each up roughly 2.5%.
The gains contrasted with weakness in chipmakers and AI megacap names.

articles.title: Oil spike weighs on equities as Brent and WTI jump
bullets: Reuters reported Brent crude up 3.6% to $108.31 early Monday.
U.S. WTI crude rose 3.3% to $103.35.
Higher oil prices added to pressure on stocks already facing AI and rate-hike concerns.

business.label: Business
business.subtitle: Corporate and economy stories driving markets

articles.title: OpenAI delays 2026 IPO as Altman cites AI safety concerns
bullets: Sam Altman said OpenAI will not go public in 2026.
He said current AI safety concerns make an IPO poorly timed.
The decision delays one of the most anticipated tech listings.

articles.title: Nvidia in talks to invest up to $10 billion in Anthropic IPO
bullets: Reuters reported Nvidia is discussing an anchor investment in Anthropic’s planned IPO.
Anthropic is seeking to raise as much as $100 billion, according to people familiar with the talks.
The potential deal would deepen Nvidia’s ties with a major AI customer.

articles.title: Trump says he will lift 10% tariff on Irish whiskey
bullets: Trump announced the planned tariff removal during a golf event in Ireland.
Irish whiskey currently faces a 10% U.S. tariff under AP’s report.
The move would affect a major Irish export to the U.S. market.

articles.title: Crypto bill advances after Trump accepts ethics provisions
bullets: Trump agreed to ethics language in sweeping Senate cryptocurrency legislation, GOP senators said.
The bill includes provisions addressing exchanges and barred digital assets.
The package is headed toward a key vote this week.

articles.title: Saudi pipeline outage raises energy-market worries for global businesses
bullets: A major Saudi pipeline struck last week will be mostly offline for several weeks.
The outage comes as Houthi attacks and Red Sea instability threaten energy shipments.
The disruption is feeding concerns about oil prices and inflation-sensitive industries.

tech.label: Tech
tech.subtitle: Technology and AI developments from the past 1–2 days

articles.title: New AI risk warnings revive debate over whether advanced systems could escape control
bullets: AP reported renewed warnings from inside the AI industry about advanced-system risks.
The debate centers on whether companies are doing enough to prevent loss of control.
Past statements on AI extinction risk have been backed by hundreds of researchers and executives.

articles.title: Anthropic CEO calls for slower AI development to let safeguards catch up
bullets: Dario Amodei said the AI industry should slow rapid frontier-model development.
He argued safety measures need time to keep pace with capability gains.
OpenAI’s Sam Altman and xAI’s Elon Musk publicly supported the general call for pacing.

articles.title: Beijing rejects Anthropic CEO’s call to curb China’s AI capabilities
bullets: China’s Foreign Ministry responded to Amodei’s comments on limiting China’s AI development.
The dispute comes ahead of a planned Trump-Xi meeting where AI governance may be discussed.
U.S. agencies recently warned about Chinese efforts to extract capabilities from advanced U.S. AI models.

articles.title: Trump says U.S. should not overcheck AI development because of China race
bullets: Trump said he does not want the U.S. to cede its AI edge to China.
He acknowledged some need for regulation but did not provide detailed rules.
His position contrasts with industry leaders calling for a slower development pace.

articles.title: OpenAI faces Senate scrutiny after Hugging Face breach, Axios reports
bullets: Axios reported a Senate probe tied to the OpenAI-Hugging Face breach.
The investigation follows rising concern in Congress over AI-powered cyber risks.
The breach has become a key example in calls for stronger AI safety oversight.
